text:
Rowan: Quick check  who's doing something Saturday? Brewery tasting in the afternoon or an easy forest hike + picnic in the morning?
Sofia: Im leaning hike + picnic. fresh air > hops these days. will bring a sandwich platter.
Ike: Brewery sounds fun but low-key. can we do both? hike in AM then brewery for late lunch?
Lilah: I can only do afternoon, so brewery works best for me. also can bring snacks if we end up picnic-ing later.
Rowan: Hmm maybe split crew then. small poll: hike AM / brewery PM / both?
Sofia: hike AM > both > brewery.
Ike: both > brewery > hike.
Lilah: brewery > both > hike.
Rowan: both > hike > brewery.
EventBot: poll closed: both wins (3 votes). created event "Hike + Brewery Shuffle" Sat 2026-10-10 08:30 PST  attendees: Rowan, Sofia, Ike, Lilah  https://calendar.example/evt/555666
Rowan: Plan: meet at Pine Trailhead 8:30, 90min loop, picnic at clearing. Brewery meet 1:00pm at Northlight Brewing (outdoor patio).
Sofia: Ill bring a picnic blanket, some hummus, and a deck of cards.
Ike: Ill handle directions and a small first-aid kit. also bringing a collapsible cooler for the brewery extras.
Lilah: Ill swing by the brewery to grab a table around 12:50 and bring a portable charger.
Rowan: Weather looks sunny with a breeze, temps in the high 60s. shoes and layers recommended.
Sofia: Can someone bring reusable plates? trying to cut single-use stuff this time.
Ike: Yep I have a set of 4 reusable bamboo plates and cutlery.
Lilah: If plan changes DM me  I might need to bail if my ride falls through.
Rowan: Cool. quick reminder: leave no trace, pack out trash, and tag pics #redwood-weekend if you post.
EventBot: reminder set for attendees 2 hours before hike.
Sofia: See yall Saturday  excited for both! :seedling:
Ike: Same here  8:30 bright and early. :hiking_boot: :beer:
Lilah: See you at the brewery for round two. :beers:
